notes: Curated eval for win-loss synthesis. Output checks require sample shape and evidence vs interpretation before recommendations.

should_trigger.prompt: Please synthesize win-loss interviews, notes, and deal evidence into clear themes and actions.
I need to understand why deals were won or lost, how patterns vary by segment or competitor, or what to change in messaging, process, or coaching.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable win loss synthesis and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please create seller-ready competitor battlecards with fit guidance, discovery questions, supported responses, proof, and escalation boundaries.
Please synthesize multi-source field feedback into traceable themes, segment differences, evidence limits, and owner-ready actions for enablement, product marketing, sales leadership, or product.
Please analyze a defined set of sales calls or notes and produce an evidence-backed objection brief by segment, persona, or stage.

output_structure_checks.name: win-loss-sample-shape
output_structure_checks.description: Shows sample accounting with eligible population, participation, evidence coverage, exclusions, and denominators before prevalence language.

output_structure_checks.name: win-loss-evidence-vs-interpretation
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps observed fact, stakeholder-reported reason, contributing factor, and analyst root-cause hypothesis distinct.

output_structure_checks.name: win-loss-finding-confidence
output_structure_checks.description: Attaches supporting deals, counterexamples, source mix, and confidence to each material finding.

output_structure_checks.name: win-loss-no-invention
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent win rates, treat interview shares as population prevalence, or publish a battlecard or governed objection library.
